subject.title: fix(android): keep composer media with its chat

question: Should Android accept the v4-to-v8 persisted owner migration, including parking legacy ownerless outbox rows for manual recovery and retaining the last verified default agent per gateway across reconnects and process restarts?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but choosing the permanent upgrade and recovery behavior for existing persisted messages is an Android product/compatibility decision that tests alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept the guarded migration
options.body: Approve the owner-scoped schema and manual-recovery contract after refreshed exact-head Android and gateway gates confirm fresh-install and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Split persistent ownership
options.body: Land only transient composer isolation now and move cache/outbox schema and recovery changes into a separately reviewed migration PR, accepting an incomplete invariant temporarily.

options.title: Pause for broader upgrade proof
options.body: Hold the PR until an installed older Android database is upgraded and its queued-message recovery flow is demonstrated end to end.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded migration
recommendation.body: Approve the owner-scoped schema and manual-recovery contract after refreshed exact-head Android and gateway gates confirm fresh-install and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision governs Android application persistence, composer behavior, and recovery UX, matching the documented Android ownership area.
